question: Should every currently complete app locale become a mandatory lockstep CI gate for each new English localization key?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes contribution policy for 22 locales; tests can prove key parity but cannot decide whether that ongoing maintenance burden is the repository's desired localization policy.

options.title: Adopt lockstep coverage
options.body: Merge the completeLocales policy after real app proof confirms representative translations render correctly.

options.title: Keep selected strict locales
options.body: Land the translations but limit missing-key failures to an explicitly maintained subset and leave other catalogs warning-only.

options.title: Defer checker policy
options.body: Merge catalog completion separately and revisit permanent CI enforcement with a dedicated localization-policy change.

recommendation.title: Adopt lockstep coverage
recommendation.body: Merge the completeLocales policy after real app proof confirms representative translations render correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and release merger, steipete is the strongest available decision owner for a contribution-wide CI policy.
